text:
Claudia (Marketing): Need a compact ops one-pager for SREs/platform/security teams — field-ready PDF for next week's launch. Must be scannable: 3 key metrics, 3 ops capabilities, tiny inbound routing note. Goal: 1-minute read. Can design mock by EOD if copy locks. :hourglass:

Raj (Product): Got it. Proposed anchors (keep short): SLA target 99.95%; p95 hosted text-gen <150ms; embedding throughput ~11k reqs/sec per dedicated pod. Callouts: prefix/KV caching, autoscale windows, burst lanes.

Mei (Sales Eng): Ops-friendly numbers make sense. Add quantization payoff: int8 profiles => ~2-3x throughput; batching yields ~30-55% token cost reduction depending on prompt shape. Emphasize deterministic tail behavior and fallback policy: "automated fallback to compatible model variants under load." 

Nora (Design): Layout idea — vertical quickbrief: header + 3 metric badges, 3 capability microbullets, one-line security microcopy, tiny footer routing. I can produce 2 colorways in 90 minutes once copy is final. 

Tom (Solutions): Routing rules for the download form:
- Default: SDR -> AE queue
- If "Regulated" or "Data residency" checked -> auto-assign AE + Solutions Eng
- If GovCloud requested -> AE + Security review
Add SFDC flags: DeployInterest and PrivacyRisk. AE checklist: region, certs (SOC2/ISO27001), KMS requirement, private deploy timeline.

Zoe (DemandGen): We'll pair with a short benchmark clip (90s). CTA: "Watch 90s perf highlights" -> landing page with deploy & compliance checkboxes. Ill A/B CTA copy vs "See perf highlights" and own paid/social promos.

Mei (Sales Eng): Quick ops curl snippets to drop in footer for field testing (2-line each):
```
# latency check (generate)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-2.1-small","prompt":"healthcheck"}'
```
```
# embeddings smoke test
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"ping"}'
```

Nora (Design): Security microcopy suggestion: "Customer-managed KMS/HSM, VPC-only control plane option, audit logs exportable to SIEM." Keep to one line.

Raj (Product): Add one-liner on reserved capacity: "Dedicated pools support configurable autoscale windows and burst lanes for spiky traffic." Keep concise.

Tom (Solutions): For regulated buyers add 3-item AE quick checklist (paste into Confluence): confirm region & residency; validate required certs; outline private deploy timeline (typical 6-8 weeks incl. security review). I'll link the checklist to the asset.

deploy-bot: Asset uploaded -> s3://marketing-assets/quickbriefs/ops-launch-quickbrief_v1.pdf :package: (preview link)

Claudia (Marketing): Love it. Final copy decisions: use Raj's metrics, Mei's curl snippets, Nora's microcopy, and Tom's routing note in footer: "Need GovCloud/private deploy? Email enterprise@redwood.com — regulated downloads auto-flag for AE follow-up." Nora, please mock off the s3 preview and push variants. Zoe, share landing URL when ready. Will lock asset tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
